simple.meaning: an angle (as projecting), i.e. (by implication) a corner-column (or anta)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to זָוִית (H2106) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

simple.summary: זָוִית (zâvîyth) means an angle (as projecting), i.e. (by implication) a corner-column (or anta) First listed occurrence: Ps 144 12.

definitions.short: an angle (as projecting), i.e. (by implication) a corner-column (or anta)
definitions.full: H2106. zavith [ זָוִית ] noun feminine corner (late (Aramaic זָוִיתָא , (often for Hebrew מִקְצוֺעַ מִּנָּה, ), hence, as loan-word (Frä Aramaic Fremdw. 11, 168 ) Arabic ); — Plural absolute זָוִיּוֺת Psa 144:12 ; construct זָוִיֹּת Zech 9:15 ; — מִוְבֵּךְַ כְּזָוִיֹּת כַמִּזְרָק וּמָֽלְאוּ 9:15 simil. of warriors streaming with blood, see Lev 1:5 , 11 etc.; ׳וגו כְּז ׳בְּנוֺתֵינוּ Psa 144:12 out daughters like corner (-pillar) s , carved (so Che and others, but see II. חטב ) in palace-fashion.
